items.title: W.T. "Ed" Kirkeby Interview, 1961-06-28
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] I think Kush has mentioned the Alamo as a place where he played with Durante and Baquet... [INTERVIEWEE] Could be. Could be.

ctx.x: Jimmy Durante uptown? Yeah. May have been.
I think Kush has mentioned the Alamo as a place where he played with Durante and Baquet, and he thought that they were considerably imitative of the original New Orleans jazz band.
